title: SLASH · The green coat
venue: Box 4B · sixty pages · never lettered for print
logline: Page one of the phantom novel: a woman in a green coat at the frame shop's counter at closing with a photograph she wants matted and won't let the framer see. Rain in the alley in vertical hatching. The framer isn't Wood; he has Wood's hands.

panels.composition: Top third: the frame shop at closing from the alley door, rain hatched in vertical strokes across the window, the OPEN sign turned, the counter lit, the GREEN COAT at it with her back to us.

characters.pose: at the counter, back to us

image.prompt: black and white noir comic page, brush-pen over blue pencil, rain as dense vertical hatching, stark black spotting, a frame shop at closing seen from its alley door with rain hatched in vertical strokes across the window and a woman in a dark coat at the lit counter with her back to the viewer
image.notes: The coat is green; the page is black and white. The color is in the title.

panels.composition: Middle third: across the counter, the GREEN COAT sliding a photograph face down toward the FRAMER's ink-stained hands, which rest flat and do not turn it over.

balloons.text: Mat it. Don't look at it.

panels.composition: Bottom third, no gutter: the photograph's back, blank, under the framer's fingertips; her gloved hand leaving the frame; the rain's hatching heaviest here.
